task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and returns True if it follows AWS naming conventions (lowercase, 3-63 characters, no consecutive dots), False otherwise.
Create a JSON object representing an AWS IAM policy that allows read-only access to all objects in an S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'.
Write a regex pattern that validates AWS IAM role ARNs in the format 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RoleName'.
